name: string-boundaries
source:
Print Left$("",-1)
Print Mid$("abc",4,-1)
Print Right$("abc",0)
Print Len(String$("x",65535))
Print Len(String$("x",65536))
Print Len(Space$(65537))
Print Len(String$("x",65470)+"y")
Print Len(""+String$("x",65535))
Print Len(String$("",-1))
Print Upper$("a"+Chr$(0)+Chr$(255))

encoding.notes: Explicit original token offsets for Left$=0x528, Right$=0x536, Mid$=0x50e, String$=0x56c, Space$=0x55e, Len=0x5da, Upper$=0x57c, Print=0x476 and plus=0xffc0. Payloads and line lengths are assembled independently without production tables or helpers. The final raw literal contains 61 00 ff; readable source uses Chr$.

evidence.notes: RFnMid rejects negative offsets then returns for past-end offsets before checking count. RString stores and loops with word lengths; String$ with empty source replaces its count with zero. Op_Plus checks String_Max=0xffc0 only when both operands are nonempty. Upper$ maps only ASCII lowercase bytes. Logical return values are derived from source; no AMOS heap capacity or allocation failures are modeled, and no target AMOS execution was captured.
